title: GraphQL Subscriptions
description: Implement GraphQL subscriptions with pub/sub, triggering on mutations, multiple subscribers, and unsubscribe support.

steps.title: Subscription endpoint
steps.description: Create a subscription endpoint that supports GraphQL subscriptions. A subscription { postAdded { title } } should be accepted.
hints: Use graphql-subscriptions with PubSub and SubscriptionServer
Define a Subscription type in the schema

codeTemplate.python:
from fastapi import FastAPI
from graphene import ObjectType, Int, String, Field, Schema
from fastapi_gql import GQL
import asyncio

app = FastAPI()

class Post(ObjectType):
    id = Int()
    title = String()

class Query(ObjectType):
    _ = String()

schema = Schema(query=Query)
GQL(app, schema=schema)

# Note: Subscriptions require WebSocket support via fastapi-gql or similar

steps.title: Trigger subscription via mutation
steps.description: When a post is created via mutation, the subscription is triggered and subscribers receive the new post. Store results for verification.
hints: Add a createPost mutation that publishes to POST_ADDED
Subscribers to postAdded receive the new post

steps.title: Get subscription status
steps.description: Create GET /subscriptions/:id that returns the current status of a subscription connection.
hints: Track active subscriptions in a map with IDs
Each subscription has an ID and status (active/completed)

steps.title: Multiple subscribers
steps.description: Multiple subscribers to the same subscription each receive the notification when a mutation triggers it.
hints: Each subscriber gets a separate connection
Store received events per subscriber for verification

steps.title: Unsubscribe
steps.description: Allow subscribers to unsubscribe. After unsubscribing, they no longer receive updates when new posts are created.
hints: Create POST /unsubscribe/:id to remove a subscriber
Use pubsub.unsubscribe to remove the listener
Verify by checking received count after a mutation
